headline: Record investment fuels broad growth, guidance raised
summary_short: Agree Realty grew Q2 2026 revenue 16.9% y/y to $205.1 million and net income 11.1% y/y to $54.7 million ($0.44 diluted EPS), while Core FFO and AFFO per share rose 7.5% and 7.4% to $1.13 and $1.14, and the company raised full-year 2026 AFFO-per-share guidance to $4.57-$4.59.
summary_long: Revenue rose 16.9% y/y to $205.1 million on a Company-record approximately $502 million of Q2 investment across 102 properties, while Core FFO per share grew 7.5% to $1.13 and AFFO per share grew 7.4% to $1.14. GAAP net income grew only 2.2% per share to $0.44, lagging Core FFO/AFFO growth because higher depreciation ($69.1 million vs $58.9 million) and a larger impairment provision ($5.9 million vs $3.0 million) are excluded from FFO/AFFO but embedded in GAAP net income. The company raised full-year 2026 AFFO-per-share guidance to $4.57-$4.59 and investment guidance to $1.6-$1.8 billion. Balance sheet: proforma net debt/recurring EBITDA of 3.7x, cash of $12.5 million, and $1.9 billion of total liquidity.

drivers.explanation: Record $502 million of quarterly investment across 102 properties, plus $1.9 billion of liquidity and robust activity across all three external growth platforms, underpinned the raised full-year 2026 AFFO-per-share and investment guidance per the CEO's comments.
Growth was supported by a Company-record approximately $502 million invested in 102 retail net lease properties this quarter, expanding the rent-paying portfolio.
EPS growth (+2.2%) lagged Core FFO/AFFO per-share growth (+7.5%/+7.4%) because higher depreciation and a larger impairment provision are embedded in GAAP net income but added back in FFO/AFFO.

Growth tracks the revenue increase from record investment activity, partly offset by a larger impairment provision ($5.9 million vs $3.0 million) and higher net interest expense ($40.3 million vs $32.3 million).
Growth reflects retained earnings plus $313.3 million of net proceeds from settling forward equity and continued ATM equity issuance during the quarter.
Share count grew after the Company settled 4.3 million shares of outstanding forward equity for net proceeds of approximately $313 million.
